name: translate
description: 翻译：Google translate 免费端点 + MyMemory 双源，取一致结果

to.description: 目标语言，如 zh-CN / en / ja

sources.name: google
sources.code: const u='https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx&sl='+encodeURIComponent(params.from||'auto')+'&tl='+encodeURIComponent(params.to||'zh-CN')+'&dt=t&q='+encodeURIComponent(params.text); const r=await fetch(u,{headers:{'user-agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}}); if(!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status); const j=await r.json(); const out=(j[0]||[]).map(x=>x[0]).join(''); return [{source:'google',text:out,languages:{from:j[2]||null,to:params.to||'zh-CN'}}];

sources.name: mymemory
sources.code: const src=(params.from==='auto'||!params.from)?'en':params.from; const u='https://api.mymemory.translated.net/get?q='+encodeURIComponent(params.text)+'&langpair='+encodeURIComponent(src+'|'+(params.to||'zh-CN')); const r=await fetch(u); if(!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status); const j=await r.json(); return [{source:'mymemory',text:j.responseData?.translatedText||'',quality:j.responseData?.match||0}];
